title: Points Balance Charging Conditions on Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Domestic Main Cabin Awards
content:
**Condition.** For a domestic Crestline Main Cabin round-trip award redeemed from Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements company points, the award points balance is read from the agreement's points entries as every accrual and every bonus, less every redemption and every expiry. The award points balance decides how the adjusted domestic award price — the price as it stands once any percentages on it have been applied and it has been rounded to the whole point — is charged:

| Award points balance | Price charged |
|---|---|
| at least 50 times the standard domestic award price | 90 percent of the adjusted price, rounded down to the next lower award step of 50 points |
| at least 10 times the standard domestic award price, and below 50 times | the adjusted price less 100 points |
| below 10 times the standard domestic award price | the adjusted price as it stands |

The standard domestic award price is the tier's domestic Main Cabin round-trip award points:

| Tier | Standard domestic award price (points) | 10 times (points) | 50 times (points) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | 1600 | 16000 | 80000 |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | 1600 | 16000 | 80000 |
| Crestline Corporate Select | 1600 | 16000 | 80000 |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | 1600 | 16000 | 80000 |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | 1600 | 16000 | 80000 |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | 1600 | 16000 | 80000 |

"Rounded down to the next lower award step" means lowered to the nearest multiple of 50 points at or below the figure. The points so charged are the points redeemed for the award.

### Worked figures (hypothetical adjusted price of 1374 points)

| Award points balance | Computation | Charged |
|---|---|---|
| 90000 | 90 percent of 1374 is 1236.6, rounded down to a multiple of 50 | 1200 |
| 80000 | same | 1200 |
| 79999 | 1374 less 100 | 1274 |
| 16000 | same | 1274 |
| 15999 | as it stands | 1374 |
